measurement_overlap: Initial paired offline process overlapped performance warmup/early first-run calls; retained as workload provenance. Do not claim this proves superiority. If a threshold fails, repeat requires recording this concrete workload anomaly before a new isolated run; thresholds remain fixed.
acceptance: Compare every raw run with fixed thresholds; both latency and allocations must PASS for all3kinds. No changing thresholds or discarding failures.
